programmes.title: Herbal Symphony
programmes.description: , Episode 3, Season 1. Autumn in Japan's oldest private medicinal herb garden in Uda, Nara Prefecture. As the plants bear fruit, the garden's custodians protect the seeds, ensuring that they live on for future generations.

programmes.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE: Bustling Scenes of Old Tokyo
programmes.description: , Episode 9, Season 2. A series of doodles by the famous artist Utagawa Kuniyoshi turn out to be carefully considered depictions of the kabuki actors of the day. What kind of artistic statement was he trying to make.

programmes.title: Today's Close Up
programmes.description: . There are more middle-aged and older single people in Japan than ever before, but not many landlords are willing to rent to them. We look at the causes and possible solutions to the problem. Hiroko Kuniya, Takeshige Morimoto.

programmes.title: Document 72 Hours
programmes.description: . Every six months, a mobile dental team travels to remote islands of Kagoshima Prefecture that have no dentist. For three days, we watched locals get checkups to get a glimpse of life there. Masako Nishijima.
